data.one_liner: A ticket view widget for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable ticket view widget that supports left and right children layout sections. It includes a standard click behavior with tap animation support.
use_when: You need to display a ticket-shaped UI component in your app
You want a widget with split content areas for boarding passes or coupons
strengths: Includes tap animation out of the box
Easy to integrate into standard Scaffold layouts
weaknesses: Does not work on the web platform
Support for macOS is not guaranteed
data.minimal_example:
TicketMaterial(
  height: 150,
  colorBackground: Colors.blue,
  leftChild: Center(child: Text('LEFT PART')),
  rightChild: Center(child: Icon(Icons.airplanemode_active)),
)
